summary: This directory contains the primary use case logic for managing greeting entities. It serves as the orchestration layer where business requirements are translated into executable actions such as creation and modification of greeting data.
responsibilities: Execute core business logic for greeting management
Orchestrate operations related to the lifecycle of greeting objects
Provide public entry points for executing domain-specific tasks
relationships: Use cases invoke internal utilities to perform common helper tasks during business processes.
Operations within the use case layer coordinate the transformation of data through internal service logic.
designDecisions: Centralized entry point for domain operations
Separation of concerns by encapsulating domain tasks into discrete units
Dependency on internal utility layer for shared procedural logic
